author: CarefulReader
text_post: I am absolutely sick of being incel / loveshy. As I stated in my intro, I've known about LS since the mid-2000s, and have made no progress since. I've gone through several phases of distracting myself with nonsense, telling myself I can never get out of it, negative depressive spirals, etc. In other words, highly counterproductive stuff, everything but what I needed to do to get out of my predicament. Well recently the realization hit me like a brick. I've spent the past decade basically wasting time. I haven't even asked anyone out. If don't get myself together now, there may not be anything left to put together. I'm already inching toward my mid 30s and know that successfully obtaining DSR will get harder from here on out. Since my realization I've already taken positive steps. I'm regularly working out in the gym, both to improve my self-confidence and to make myself as physically appealing as possible. I'm updating my wardrobe. I've signed up for several dating apps, and will start using them when I can take a good picture. But I want results. And that's why I, CarefulReader, resolve to have at least one date or sexual experience by January, 2020.
